body:
This `elevation_` and related code can be removed as elevation is used in 3D only with the 2d-avoidance simulation that is plane projected.

It is used to restrict the avoidance so agents in multi-storey buildings on the y-axis ignore each other when an agent is at the bottom and the other on the roof.
